plainTranslation: Composite Neptune in the 5 House: With Composite Neptune in the 5th house, this can make you feel you have a soul connection in a personal relationship, and especially in a romantic relationship. You can be more creative and inspired with one another, and can enjoy spending time being artistic, helping others, or using your imagination. In a parent-child relationship, one of you may be more distant, and you have a hard time connecting.
policy: Composite chart entries describe the relationship as a third entity. Read alongside synastry; do not use as a verdict on whether a relationship should continue.
note: Imported from The Dark Pixie Astrology composites material text.
